nom: BYOMA Blemish Acne Treatment Spot Paste

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had a fluke breakout on my chin, so it was the perfect time to try this product. I liked that it was tinted, and it felt tingly when I put it on. However, I really didn't notice a difference after using it. I put it on at bedtime and when I washed it off in the morning, there was no change. Unfortunately, I had higher hopes for this acne paste.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ive tried several different salicylic acid spot treatments over the years and this is one of my favorites. It has the clay ingredient which helps to dry out any acne spots, but it hasn't made the skin around the spot dry or rough. My favorite thing about the product is its color. I normally go makeup free or very light makeup and the color of the clay works for me as a concealer. It would not be that way for darker skin tones, but I am fair /medium olive toned skin and I love using it as such.

avis.titre: Didn't work great for my hormonal acne
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have pretty bad hormonal acne. I used this product for 2 weeks after cleansing and before bed. I don't think it did much, it wiped off as soon as I laid down to sleep. I probably would rather wear this during the day when I'm home as a mask to see if it helps. The texture or scent didn't bother my or my sensitive skin at all

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Spot acne treatments are my favorite, as someone who doesn't break out a lot they are really convenient and also help me reduce the urge to mess with a pimple too early. So I was really happy to see this type of applicator on this product since it's really easy to use and the most hygienic. The treatment itself was a little bit interesting in texture since it was more like a moisturizer vs the other treatments I've used that's more like a paste but it still came out of the tube easy and I didn't feel it on my skin. The treatment not having really any sort of smell (unless you purposely smell it) also helps it to not feel noticeable on your skin. Since it is a spot treatment it is noticeable by appearance so I personally only like to apply it if I know I'm going to be home for the entire day or when I get home and as long as I don't touch the area or get it wet the treatment stays on my skin once it dries down. Depending on the pimple and me only using the product for a couple hours a day I can notice a pimple disappearing in 1-2 days with this treatment which I really like. It's a way better alternative than just trying to pop a pimple yourself. ￼

I used this consistently on my son's nose for a couple of weeks, and I didn't notice much of a difference. I put a pea size amount of the product on his nose at night. The product itself is fine. There wasn't any weird scent to it, and it was easy to apply.

In no more then 2 days my pimple was clear. This is fast acting, only need a little bit and absorbs nice. Not greasy and blends well if putting makeup on after. Does not smell strong and works its magic!

avis.titre: Nice/unique texture, helps with pimple pain
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can't say that I love this product or that I hate it. Due to the clay in the product I feel like it dried out my pimples well but it also made it smell like mold (luckily the smell doesn't linger-I'm very sensitive to smells). The before and after pictures are only 2 days difference and while I think my pimple may have gotten redder, it's much flatter and no longer painful. I will continue to use it and may repurchase it eventually since it's a fairly unique product in my opinion and at a good price point.
